name: Reels, Lines and Hooks
description: Every part a rod takes, with its ratings.

pages.title: Reels, Lines and Hooks
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- **Reel**: its top drag, speed and line held.
- **Line**: its **test** (the pull it snaps at), stretch and visibility.
- **Hook** size picks the fish's size.
- Floats, sinkers and lures set how bait is shown.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() Tackle is made from Create parts in a crafting grid: cogwheels, shafts, precision mechanisms, andesite alloy, iron, copper and brass sheets, plus TFMG's steel, plastic and rubber. [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() shows every recipe.

pages.title: Reels
pages.text:
Max drag, line held:

- Copper Spinning: 3 kg, 100 m
- Iron Spinning: 6 kg, 150 m
- Brass Precision: 10 kg, 200 m
- Steel Baitcaster: 14 kg, 180 m
- Big-Game Trolling: 30 kg, 600 m

Better reels also wind faster (1 to 1.8 m/s), crank harder against a pulling fish, and give a **smoother** drag that soaks sudden spikes: 30%% on the Copper reel, 85%% on the Brass Precision reel.\
\
Reel durability: Copper 300, Iron 500, Brass and Steel 900, Big-Game 1500. A reel that breaks is gone.

pages.title: Lines
pages.text: A spool goes in the line slot. Its tooltip shows its test, stretch, visibility and the metres left.

**Lines**: test, stretch, visibility, metres.

- String: 4 kg, 70%%, 70%%, 100
- Mono: 8 kg, 50%%, 40%%, 150
- Clear: 10 kg, 30%%, 10%%, 150
- Braided: 18 kg, 10%%, 80%%, 200
- Heavy Mono: 50 kg, 45%%, 50%%, 600

**Stretch** soaks shocks; braid barely stretches, so jumps hit hard. Shy fish (trout, salmon, carp, koi, char, grayling, bonefish) mind a **visible** line and bite less.\
\
Braided Line is spun from 8 of TFMG's **Synthetic String** (a Rubber Sheet on a stonecutter makes 4) around a stick.\
\
Under 5 m of line left the rod can't be cast.

pages.title: Leaders
pages.text: An optional short length at the hook. **Clear Leader**: 12 kg, 10%% visible, hides a strong line from shy fish. **Iron Leader**: 12 kg, from iron nuggets and string; teeth can't cut it. **Steel Leader**: 60 kg, the same for big fish. Teeth fray anything else.

pages.title: Hooks
pages.text: Small (#10) for panfish, Medium (#4), Large (1/0) for pike, bass and carp, Big-Game (6/0) for tuna and sharks. A hook far too big for a fish scares it off; one too small holds badly.

pages.title: Golden and Netherite Hooks
pages.text: **Golden Hook**: medium size, +1 luck. **Netherite Hook**: large, survives lava. Any rod with it fishes lava.

**Special hooks** keep their effects:

- **Fiery**: water counts as warmer, so warm-water fish bite.
- **Permafrost**: water counts as colder.
- **Twilight**: fish act as if it were 12 hours later.
- **Lavaproof**: fishes lava.
- **Hook of the Depths**: fishes the void.

**Hybrid Aquatic hooks** fit too:

- **Barbed**: bites a quarter sooner by day, holds better.
- **Glowing**: bites a quarter sooner at night.
- **Magnetic**: +1 luck, twice the treasure and crates.
- **CreeperMagnet**: the next bite is a creeper, flung at you.

- **Ominous** (9 different crab claws): the next bite brings up **Karkinos**, Hybrid Aquatic's giant crab boss.

CreeperMagnet and Ominous hooks wear with each use.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** Karkinos lands at your feet. Fish from somewhere you can fight.

pages.title: Float and Lead Sinker
pages.text: **Float** (4 g): bait at the surface, dips on a bite. **Lead Sinker** (15 g): bait on the bottom. Bobbers of every look (dyes, apples, gems, a duck and more) work as floats.

pages.title: Lures
pages.text:
Dive depth, best speed (m/s):

- Spinner: 0.6 m, 0.3-1.8
- Spoon: 1 m, 0.4-2.5
- Crankbait: 2 m, 0.6-3
- Deep Crankbait: 5 m, 0.8-3.5

- Jig: 3 m, 0.1-1, worked slowly near the bottom.
- Popper: on the surface, 0.2-1.5.
- Soft Plastic Worm: 1 m, 0.1-1.2.

Lures are kept between bites and lost only with the line. Predators like them best; see [#](2E5AAC)[Bait](entry://fishing/bait)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** **Hook sizes** run from #12 (smallest) through #1, then 1/0 up to 8/0. The ideal hook grows with the fish: #12 for a 5 cm fish, 4/0 for a 2 m one. Bait size counts too: a big bait finds bigger fish.\
\
**Lure weights**: Soft Plastic Worm 6 g, Spinner 8 g, Jig and Popper 10 g, Spoon 12 g, Crankbait 14 g, Deep Crankbait 20 g.
